blocks.text: From writing songs about brushing her teeth as a child to reaching listeners across the world, Ivoris has discovered how personal stories can resonate with people in ways an artist never expects. Photo Credit Isabella Salvatore The singer-songwriter and producer recently released her debut album, Pour My Heart Out, inspired by the ocean and the many emotions that come with being human. The album also features “Lipgloss,” a collaboration with Manila-based singer-songwriter Clara Benin. In an exclusive interview with INQ POP!, Ivoris opened up about her songwriting journey, the stories behind her album, and her growing connection with Filipino fans. Ivoris […]...
